summary: Defines a connectivity precondition for the Session Description Protocol (SDP) precondition framework. It lets session setup or changes wait until media stream connectivity has been verified, by probing the stream for UDP or by connection establishment for TCP. It is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: Before starting a game of catch, you check your friend can actually catch. This lets two devices test that data really flows before starting a call.

questions: how to verify media connectivity before sip call
